data.body: Plan review 2026-10-19 (BLOCK, deterministic P11 ac-vagueness, no LLM findings): one AC item was flagged for subjective wording ("client-appropriate default", "path-identical", chained "and"). Description rewritten so each of the three criteria names the exact function, path, grep, build command, or tracker query that proves it, and each names the child story that delivers it. The config-seam story d279 is already certified at f147e08242f; this epic's certificate is the last gate before a lane can claim it.
